bond-ladder.title: Let three coupon bonds mature without renewal
bond-ladder.inputs:
settlement: 2026-12-01; rungs: 10000, 100, 4, 2, 2
10000, 100, 4, 4, 2
10000, 100, 4, 6, 2; horizon_months: 36; maturity: Retain maturity proceeds; renewal_months: 36; renewal_coupon: 4
steps: All three $10,000 bonds are bought at par; initial cost = $30,000.
Semiannual coupons are $200 per bond. They pay 2, 4 and 6 remaining coupons, totaling $2,400.
Retained cash after all original maturities = $30,000 + $2,400 = $32,400.
bond-ladder.answer: Retained cash through horizon: 32,400.00 for the stated case.

bond-ladder.title: Preserve a premium-bond redemption loss
bond-ladder.inputs: settlement: 2026-12-01; rungs: 10000, 105, 2, 2, 2; horizon_months: 12; maturity: Retain maturity proceeds; renewal_months: 36; renewal_coupon: 4
steps: Pay $10,500 for $10,000 face. Two $100 coupons total $200.
Maturity returns $10,000, so cash is $10,200 and cash-flow gain is −$300. No tax amortization is inferred.
bond-ladder.answer: Realized cash-flow gain, not tax income: -300.00 for the stated case.

expected.label: Realized cash-flow gain, not tax income

bond-ladder.title: Roll coupon principal at par and keep coupons in cash
bond-ladder.inputs:
settlement: 2026-12-01; rungs: 10000, 100, 4, 2, 2
10000, 100, 4, 4, 2
10000, 100, 4, 6, 2; horizon_months: 36; maturity: Roll same face amount; renewal_months: 36; renewal_coupon: 4
steps: The one-year and two-year original maturities buy new three-year par bonds. Coupons remain in cash.
At month 36, $20,000 face remains outstanding and the final original $10,000 maturity stays in cash.
Coupon cash totals $3,600 across original and renewed bonds, leaving $13,600 retained cash.
bond-ladder.answer: Retained cash through horizon: 13,600.00 for the stated case.

bond-ladder.title: Separate bill principal from its discount income
bond-ladder.inputs:
settlement: 2026-12-01; rungs: 10000, 99, 28
10000, 98, 56
10000, 97, 84; horizon_days: 84; maturity: Retain maturity proceeds; renewal_days: 91; renewal_price: 98.75
steps: Purchase costs are $9,900, $9,800 and $9,700: total $29,400.
Each bill pays $10,000 face at maturity; all three redeem by day 84.
Cash is $30,000, while realized discount gain is only $600.
bond-ladder.answer: Realized discount gain through horizon: 600.00 for the stated case.

bond-ladder.title: Roll the same bill face rather than all maturity cash
bond-ladder.inputs: settlement: 2026-12-01; rungs: 10000, 99, 28; horizon_days: 56; maturity: Roll same face amount; renewal_days: 28; renewal_price: 98.75
steps: Pay $9,900 initially. Day 28 redemption pays $10,000; renewal costs $9,875 at a price of 98.75 per $100, leaving $125 cash.
Day 56 is the horizon, so the renewed bill pays $10,000 without another renewal.
Retained cash is $10,125; subtract original $9,900 for realized cash-flow gain $225.
bond-ladder.answer: Retained cash through horizon: 10,125.00 for the stated case.

irmaa.title: Use the exact 2027 first threshold

values.status: Single / head of household / qualifying surviving spouse

irmaa.inputs: year: 2027; status: Single / head of household / qualifying surviving spouse; coverage: Part B + Part D; people: 1; part_d_plan: 35; extra_income: 1000; magi: 112000
steps: 2027 individual MAGI at 112,000 remains in the zero-IRMAA tier.
Full Part B standard premium 209.40 plus the hypothetical entered Part D plan premium 35 gives 244.40 per month; none of that is IRMAA.
irmaa.answer: Monthly IRMAA for selected people: 0.00 for the stated case.

irmaa.title: Move one dollar above the 2027 threshold

values.status: Single / head of household / qualifying surviving spouse

irmaa.inputs: year: 2027; status: Single / head of household / qualifying surviving spouse; coverage: Part B + Part D; people: 1; part_d_plan: 35; extra_income: 1000; magi: 112001
steps: 112,001 exceeds the inclusive 112,000 threshold.
Monthly Part B IRMAA 83.70 plus Part D IRMAA 15.40 = 99.10 per person.
Twelve-month surcharge = 99.10 × 12 = 1,189.20, in addition to standard and plan premiums.
irmaa.answer: 12-month IRMAA for selected people: 1,189.20 for the stated case.

irmaa.title: Count both covered people on a 2026 joint return
irmaa.inputs: year: 2026; status: Married filing jointly; coverage: Part B + Part D; people: 2; part_d_plan: 35; extra_income: 1000; magi: 218001
steps: For 2026, the usual lookback is tax year 2024. Joint MAGI 218,001 enters the first adjustment bracket.
Per person: 81.20 Part B plus 14.50 Part D = 95.70 monthly. Both covered spouses: 191.40 monthly.
irmaa.answer: Monthly IRMAA for selected people: 191.40 for the stated case.

irmaa.title: Build Medicare MAGI from known AGI and exempt interest

values.status: Single / head of household / qualifying surviving spouse

irmaa.inputs: year: 2027; status: Single / head of household / qualifying surviving spouse; coverage: Part B + Part D; people: 1; part_d_plan: 35; extra_income: 1000; agi: 110000; tax_exempt_interest: 2000
steps: Known AGI 110,000 plus tax-exempt interest 2,000 gives MAGI 112,000.
Under the 2027 individual table this is still the inclusive zero-IRMAA threshold.
irmaa.answer: MAGI used for tier lookup: 112,000.00 for the stated case.

irmaa.title: Check the exact 2027 separately-filing top boundary
irmaa.inputs: year: 2027; status: Married filing separately: lived together; coverage: Part B + Part D; people: 1; part_d_plan: 35; extra_income: 1000; magi: 388000
steps: For 2027 filing separately while living together, 388,000 begins the top tier.
Part B adjustment 502.40 plus Part D adjustment 96.40 = 598.80 monthly.
irmaa.answer: Monthly IRMAA for selected people: 598.80 for the stated case.

irmaa.title: Include only Part D when Part B is not selected

values.status: Single / head of household / qualifying surviving spouse

irmaa.inputs: year: 2027; status: Single / head of household / qualifying surviving spouse; coverage: Part D only; people: 1; part_d_plan: 35; extra_income: 1000; magi: 112001
steps: Selected Part D IRMAA is 15.40; no Part B standard premium or adjustment is included.
Add the hypothetical plan premium 35 to obtain monthly total 50.40.
irmaa.answer: Monthly total premiums for selected people: 50.40 for the stated case.
